video.description: First Short started straight from a scene reference (refs/scenes/sprocket_tractor_yard.png), no still generated. SPROCKET: a cheerful chunky cartoon piglet with a soft pink body, floppy pink ears, a big pink snout, rosy cheeks, solid glossy black eyes with a small white highlight (no coloured irises), dark brown hooves, a curly pink tail, wearing a brown leather tool belt with a gold buckle and two brown tool pouches (red-handled screwdriver + small silver tool in one, blue-handled tool in the other). The blue tractor with its grille face behind him.

beats.action: ACCEPTED v1: waves to camera: 'You hear that rattle? Something's loose.'
ACCEPTED v1: walks to the tractor (camera follows), 'Hmm.'
ACCEPTED v1: twists a grille bolt with the red screwdriver: 'A little twist...'
ACCEPTED v1: faces camera holding the screwdriver: '...and it's snug!'

notes: Pacing: 11 words + sign-off. Franchise: Sprocket fixes. Teaches: listen for the problem, a small fix can do it. Known flaw accepted by the user: from ~5.5s a second red screwdriver handle shows in his pouch while he holds one (Veo refilled the pouch); camera follows him to the tractor instead of staying locked off.
